# Data model

<!-- Generated by `npm run audit:pack` from packages/db/src/schema.ts and the migrations. Do not edit by hand. -->

26 tables. Money is integer paise (`bigint`), percentages basis points, dates civil dates (`date`), times `timestamptz`. **RLS**: `forced` is row-level security on the business column that binds the table owner too (I1); `on` binds the application role only. **Audit**: one `audit_events` row per insert and update (I7). Every business table also refuses deletes (8.3) and model writes (I6), except where a migration says otherwise.
